UPLOAD_KEY.description: Bearer secret for every `/v1/` route. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

STORAGE_BACKEND.description: Selects object storage. Use `r2` for the FILES bucket or `s3` for the S3 secrets.

MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES.description: Maximum declared upload size in bytes. The default is 104857600.

FILES.description: R2 bucket that stores share objects. The bucket name is `transfer-files`.

SHARE_TOKENS.description: Durable Object namespace that stores one share per token hash. It uses sqlite migration v1.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3-compatible origin for the s3 environment, such as MinIO or Wasabi.

S3_REGION.description: SigV4 region for the s3 environment.

S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket name for the s3 environment.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key id for the s3 environment.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret access key for the s3 environment.
